class: A list silently dropped items, and a status line stated an outcome nobody had checked
symptom: Suggested jobs the owner had already applied to vanished from the list without a word (and the query that hid them only worked when a legacy table existed). Cards showed no posting age or New badge, long location lists, and 'Remote' twice. 'Find new jobs' left no record of when it ran or how many boards it checked. The cockpit said 'Stopped.' when nothing was running and 'Checked. The agent is carrying on.' before the agent had looked.
site: Flask dashboard, suggested-jobs section and static/cockpit.js, 1 November 2026 UI review
root_cause: The view decided for the owner (hide) instead of showing and labelling, and toasts were written from what the click sent, not from what the backend or the next status refresh reported.
why_tests_missed: Tests asserted that the list rendered and that routes answered, never that an item the owner had acted on was still visible and marked, and never read the words a toast uses against the backend's own answer.
fix: discovered_view.prepare marks jobs the tracker shows as sent (by posting address or company and title, read-only), sorts them last without removing them, adds the posting age and a New badge, cuts location lists to the first place plus a count, and drops a duplicate Remote. The scan route records when it ran and how many boards it checked, and the page shows it. The cockpit reports 'Nothing was running' when the backend says not_running and shows 'Checking' on Check and Continue until the next status refresh decides.
prevention: Show and label, never silently filter what the owner can act on. Write every status message from the backend's answer or the next refresh, and test the words against the answer.
